                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}
                    else:

            found=None
            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:

            if found:
                if found in seen:

                opts[found]=val
                seen.add(found)
                i+=1
                continue
            return {'error':'unknown','opt':tok,'args':args}

def get_quote():
    sec = int(time.time())
    return QUOTES[sec % len(QUOTES)]

def format_banner(program_name):
    stripped = f":-) GROMACS - {program_name}, {VERSION_STR} (-:"
    spaces = (80 - len(stripped)) // 2
    if spaces < 0:
        spaces = 0
    return " " * spaces + stripped

def get_executable_path(argv0, cwd):
    if "/" not in argv0:
        path_env = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
        for p in path_env.split(":"):
            if not p:
                continue
            candidate = os.path.join(p, argv0)
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                if os.path.islink(candidate):
                    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
                else:
                    return argv0
        return argv0
    else:
        if os.path.isabs(argv0):
            if os.path.islink(argv0):
                return os.path.realpath(argv0)
            else:
                return argv0
        else:
            full = cwd + "/" + argv0
            candidate_path = os.path.join(cwd, argv0)
            if os.path.islink(candidate_path):
                return os.path.realpath(candidate_path)
            return full

def get_basename(argv0):
    return os.path.basename(argv0)

def format_cmdline(argv0, args):
    base = get_basename(argv0)
    if not args:
        return base
    else:
        return base + " " + " ".join(args)

def parse_args(args):
    bool_opts = ['h','quiet','version','copyright','backup']
    opts = {k: None for k in bool_opts}
    opts['nice'] = None
    seen = set()
    remaining = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        if tok.startswith('-'):
            stripped = tok.lstrip('-')
            if stripped == 'nice':
                if 'nice' in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                if i+1 >= len(args):
                    return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                val_tok = args[i+1]
                try:
                    iv = int(val_tok)
                    if not val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}
                    else:
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
            found=None
            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:
                    found=b
                    break
                if stripped == 'no'+b:
                    found=b
                    break
            if found:
                if found in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':tok,'args':args}
                is_no = stripped.startswith('no')
                val = not is_no
                opts[found]=val
                seen.add(found)
                i+=1
                continue
            return {'error':'unknown','opt':tok,'args':args}
        else:
            remaining.append(tok)
            i+=1
    return {'opts':opts,'remaining':remaining}

        base = get_basename(argv0)

def get_quote():
    sec = int(time.time())
    return QUOTES[sec % len(QUOTES)]

def format_banner(program_name):
    stripped = f":-) GROMACS - {program_name}, {VERSION_STR} (-:"
    spaces = (80 - len(stripped)) // 2
    if spaces < 0:
        spaces = 0
    return " " * spaces + stripped

def get_executable_path(argv0, cwd):
    if "/" not in argv0:
        path_env = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
        for p in path_env.split(":"):
            if not p:
                continue
            candidate = os.path.join(p, argv0)
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                if os.path.islink(candidate):
                    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
                else:
                    return argv0
        return argv0
    else:
        if os.path.isabs(argv0):
            if os.path.islink(argv0):
                return os.path.realpath(argv0)
            else:
                return argv0
        else:
            full = cwd + "/" + argv0
            candidate_path = os.path.join(cwd, argv0)
            if os.path.islink(candidate_path):
                return os.path.realpath(candidate_path)
            return full

def get_basename(argv0):
    return os.path.basename(argv0)

def format_cmdline(argv0, args):
    base = get_basename(argv0)
    if not args:
        return base
    else:
        return base + " " + " ".join(args)

def parse_args(args):
    bool_opts = ['h','quiet','version','copyright','backup']
    opts = {k: None for k in bool_opts}
    opts['nice'] = None
    seen = set()
    remaining = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        if tok.startswith('-'):
            stripped = tok.lstrip('-')
            if stripped == 'nice':
                if 'nice' in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                if i+1 >= len(args):
                    return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                val_tok = args[i+1]
                try:
                    iv = int(val_tok)
                    if not val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}
                    else:
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
            found=None
            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:
                    found=b
                    break
                if stripped == 'no'+b:
                    found=b
                    break
            if found:
                if found in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':tok,'args':args}
                is_no = stripped.startswith('no')
                val = not is_no
                opts[found]=val
                seen.add(found)
                i+=1
                continue
            return {'error':'unknown','opt':tok,'args':args}
        else:
            remaining.append(tok)
            i+=1
    return {'opts':opts,'remaining':remaining}

    if "/" not in argv0:
        path_env = os.environ.get("PATH", "")

            if not p:
                continue
            candidate = os.path.join(p, argv0)
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                if os.path.islink(candidate):
                    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
                else:

                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                if i+1 >= len(args):
                    return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                val_tok = args[i+1]
                try:
                    iv = int(val_tok)
                    if not val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}

                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}

            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:
                    found=b
                    break
                if stripped == 'no'+b:
                    found=b
                    break

                if found in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':tok,'args':args}
                is_no = stripped.startswith('no')
                val = not is_no
                opts[found]=val

    stripped = f":-) GROMACS - {program_name}, {VERSION_STR} (-:"
    spaces = (80 - len(stripped)) // 2
    if spaces < 0:
        spaces = 0
    return " " * spaces + stripped

def get_executable_path(argv0, cwd):
    if "/" not in argv0:
        path_env = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
        for p in path_env.split(":"):
            if not p:
                continue
            candidate = os.path.join(p, argv0)
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                if os.path.islink(candidate):
                    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
                else:
                    return argv0
        return argv0
    else:
        if os.path.isabs(argv0):
            if os.path.islink(argv0):
                return os.path.realpath(argv0)
            else:
                return argv0
        else:
            full = cwd + "/" + argv0
            candidate_path = os.path.join(cwd, argv0)
            if os.path.islink(candidate_path):
                return os.path.realpath(candidate_path)
            return full

def parse_args(args):
    bool_opts = ['h','quiet','version','copyright','backup']
    opts = {k: None for k in bool_opts}
    opts['nice'] = None
    seen = set()
    remaining = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        if tok.startswith('-'):
            stripped = tok.lstrip('-')
            if stripped == 'nice':
                if 'nice' in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                if i+1 >= len(args):
                    return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                val_tok = args[i+1]
                try:
                    iv = int(val_tok)
                    if not val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}
                    else:
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
            found=None
            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:
                    found=b
                    break
                if stripped == 'no'+b:
                    found=b
                    break
            if found:
                if found in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':tok,'args':args}
                is_no = stripped.startswith('no')
                val = not is_no
                opts[found]=val
                seen.add(found)
                i+=1
                continue
            return {'error':'unknown','opt':tok,'args':args}
        else:
            remaining.append(tok)
            i+=1
    return {'opts':opts,'remaining':remaining}

def format_banner(program_name):
    stripped = f":-) GROMACS - {program_name}, {VERSION_STR} (-:"
    spaces = (80 - len(stripped)) // 2
    if spaces < 0:
        spaces = 0
    return " " * spaces + stripped

def get_executable_path(argv0, cwd):
    if "/" not in argv0:
        path_env = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
        for p in path_env.split(":"):
            if not p:
                continue
            candidate = os.path.join(p, argv0)
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                if os.path.islink(candidate):
                    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
                else:
                    return argv0
        return argv0
    else:
        if os.path.isabs(argv0):
            if os.path.islink(argv0):
                return os.path.realpath(argv0)
            else:
                return argv0
        else:
            full = cwd + "/" + argv0
            candidate_path = os.path.join(cwd, argv0)
            if os.path.islink(candidate_path):
                return os.path.realpath(candidate_path)
            return full

def get_basename(argv0):
    return os.path.basename(argv0)

def format_cmdline(argv0, args):
    base = get_basename(argv0)
    if not args:

def parse_args(args):
    bool_opts = ['h','quiet','version','copyright','backup']
    opts = {k: None for k in bool_opts}
    opts['nice'] = None
    seen = set()
    remaining = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        if tok.startswith('-'):
            stripped = tok.lstrip('-')
            if stripped == 'nice':
                if 'nice' in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                if i+1 >= len(args):
                    return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                val_tok = args[i+1]
                try:
                    iv = int(val_tok)
                    if not val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}
                    else:
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
            found=None
            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:
                    found=b
                    break
                if stripped == 'no'+b:
                    found=b
                    break
            if found:
                if found in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':tok,'args':args}
                is_no = stripped.startswith('no')
                val = not is_no
                opts[found]=val
                seen.add(found)
                i+=1
                continue
            return {'error':'unknown','opt':tok,'args':args}
        else:
            remaining.append(tok)
            i+=1
    return {'opts':opts,'remaining':remaining}

def get_quote():
    sec = int(time.time())
    return QUOTES[sec % len(QUOTES)]

def format_banner(program_name):
    stripped = f":-) GROMACS - {program_name}, {VERSION_STR} (-:"
    spaces = (80 - len(stripped)) // 2
    if spaces < 0:
        spaces = 0
    return " " * spaces + stripped

def get_executable_path(argv0, cwd):
    if "/" not in argv0:
        path_env = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
        for p in path_env.split(":"):
            if not p:
                continue
            candidate = os.path.join(p, argv0)
            if os.path.exists(candidate):
                if os.path.islink(candidate):
                    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
                else:
                    return argv0
        return argv0
    else:
        if os.path.isabs(argv0):
            if os.path.islink(argv0):
                return os.path.realpath(argv0)
            else:
                return argv0
        else:
            full = cwd + "/" + argv0
            candidate_path = os.path.join(cwd, argv0)
            if os.path.islink(candidate_path):
                return os.path.realpath(candidate_path)
            return full

def get_basename(argv0):
    return os.path.basename(argv0)

def format_cmdline(argv0, args):
    base = get_basename(argv0)
    if not args:
        return base
    else:
        return base + " " + " ".join(args)

def parse_args(args):
    bool_opts = ['h','quiet','version','copyright','backup']
    opts = {k: None for k in bool_opts}
    opts['nice'] = None
    seen = set()
    remaining = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        tok = args[i]
        if tok.startswith('-'):
            stripped = tok.lstrip('-')
            if stripped == 'nice':
                if 'nice' in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                if i+1 >= len(args):
                    return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                val_tok = args[i+1]
                try:
                    iv = int(val_tok)
                    if not val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                    opts['nice']=iv
                    seen.add('nice')
                    i+=2
                    continue
                except:
                    if val_tok.startswith('-'):
                        vt = val_tok.lstrip('-')
                        is_bool=False
                        for b in bool_opts:
                            if vt == b or vt == 'no'+b:
                                is_bool=True
                                break
                        if is_bool:
                            return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
                        else:
                            return {'error':'too_few_and_unknown','opt':'-nice','unknown':val_tok,'args':args}
                    else:
                        return {'error':'too_few','opt':'-nice','args':args}
            found=None
            for b in bool_opts:
                if stripped == b:
                    found=b
                    break
                if stripped == 'no'+b:
                    found=b
                    break
            if found:
                if found in seen:
                    return {'error':'duplicate','opt':tok,'args':args}
                is_no = stripped.startswith('no')
                val = not is_no
                opts[found]=val
                seen.add(found)
                i+=1
                continue
            return {'error':'unknown','opt':tok,'args':args}
        else:
            remaining.append(tok)
            i+=1
    return {'opts':opts,'remaining':remaining}
